title.en: PCD Mobile – Digital Image Processing & AI Vision
title.id: PCD Mobile – Pengolahan Citra Digital & AI Vision

description.en: Cross-platform Flutter mobile application implementing digital image processing algorithms and real-time AI Vision, covering image acquisition, color model manipulation, frequency-domain filtering, and object detection with OpenCV.
description.id: Aplikasi mobile Flutter lintas platform yang mengimplementasikan algoritma Pengolahan Citra Digital dan AI Vision secara real-time, mencakup akuisisi citra, manipulasi model warna, filtering domain frekuensi, dan deteksi objek dengan OpenCV.

impact.en: Delivered an end-to-end mobile lab environment for digital image processing exploration — from camera acquisition and histogram equalization to Fourier-domain filtering and real-time human/pothole detection — with a clean feature-based architecture.
impact.id: Menghadirkan lingkungan lab mobile end-to-end untuk eksplorasi pengolahan citra digital — mulai akuisisi kamera dan histogram equalization hingga filtering domain Fourier dan deteksi real-time manusia/pothole — dengan arsitektur berbasis fitur yang bersih.

highlights.en: Onboarding & mock-auth module with rate-limited login lockout for access-control demonstration.
highlights.id: Modul onboarding & mock-auth dengan pembatasan login (rate-limiting lockout) untuk demonstrasi kontrol akses.

highlights.en: Full digital image processing pipeline: grayscale, RGB manipulation, histogram, histogram equalization, convolution filters, and sharpening.
highlights.id: Pipeline pengolahan citra digital lengkap: grayscale, manipulasi RGB, histogram, histogram equalization, filter konvolusi, dan sharpening.

highlights.en: Frequency-domain operations (FFT-based low/high/band-pass filtering) via native OpenCV bindings.
highlights.id: Operasi domain frekuensi (filtering low/high/band-pass berbasis FFT) melalui native OpenCV bindings.

highlights.en: Real-time AI Vision mode for human entity detection and pothole inspection with bounding-box overlay using CustomPainter.
highlights.id: Mode AI Vision real-time untuk deteksi entitas manusia dan inspeksi pothole dengan overlay bounding-box menggunakan CustomPainter.

highlights.en: Camera Overlay Processor: burn-in composite of live camera frame + AI detection layer saved directly to device storage as a static image file.
highlights.id: Camera Overlay Processor: composite burn-in frame kamera live + layer deteksi AI yang disimpan langsung ke storage perangkat sebagai file gambar statis.

highlights.en: Feature-based folder structure with strict Separation of Concerns (View, Controller, Service, Painter, Model).
highlights.id: Struktur folder berbasis fitur dengan Separation of Concerns ketat (View, Controller, Service, Painter, Model).
